svg.title: Battery box: detailed connection diagram
svg.desc: Electrical schematic, not to scale. Four battery positive branches each have a fuse. Three bars per polarity have all twelve studs allocated, with four jumpers total. EV200 is outside the battery box in the PV positive circuit.
svg.text: Electrical schematic. Component symbols and wire paths are NOT TO SCALE. Stud labels match the online layout guide.
REFERENCE: body footprints are shown to scale on sheet 2. This sheet spaces the connections for tracing.
Lines show connections only. Final cable lengths, bends, protection and device ratings remain under review.
FINV = 110 A Class T, Blue Sea 5007100 + 5112
Each positive has its own nearby source fuse.
Each negative returns to its assigned stud.
Four jumpers total: A4 to B1, B4 to C1,
on both positive and negative assemblies.
Crossed lines connect only at a labelled stud.
* Fuse values remain proposals. Review battery-branch protection for source current from either end.
EV200: outside this box, in PV positive between DIHOOL and Tycon PV+. Its coil supply comes from fused AUX control.
Body sizes: supplied product images; Class T: Blue Sea drawing 5007100. One lug per stud. No new negative-to-PE bond.
12 OCT 2026 | REV A | PRELIMINARY | SHEET 3 OF 3
